ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 distribution of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region (RGB ~240-255) bordered by high-contrast black peripheral zones (RGB ~0-25) at the leading edges and lateral tips; right lobe exhibits more extensive white coverage extending toward the leading edge compared to the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 82 degrees and a depth relative to the fluke baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; primary peaks located at the mid-lobe sections with amplitudes ranging from 8 to 15 pixels; distinct ragged topography at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve on the leading edges; trailing edges follow a generally straight trajectory with slight concavity near the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle scars/colonies) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel white linear streaks (rake marks) originating from the lower left fluke quadrant near the peduncle junction; multiple shorter, faint linear disruptions visible on the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white rake marks on the left lobe; extensive irregular scarring and crustose accumulation at the fluke tips creating localized edge deformation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled 'splatter' transition zone on the right lobe trailing edge where black pigmentation fragments into white pixels.
